scam_ham_india_14_languages.excluded_notes: 10,000 non-target languages dropped (as, gu, kn, ks, ml, mr, or, pa, ta, te); 453 rows held out in indic_test_suite_clean dev set.

indian_scam_sms_synthetic_audited.excluded_notes: Synthetic ratio cap (<= 30% of training); held entirely in train only to prevent synthetic validation contamination; remaining 271 rows capped.

scam_ham_india_anmol.excluded_notes: Clean English spam/ham from Indian mobile users.

india_spam_sms_junioralive.excluded_notes: 2,053 rows were exact/normalized duplicates of scam_ham_india_anmol; remaining 214 collapsed into anmol template clusters.

cloveai_india_spam.excluded_notes: Label 1 (10,005 rows) dropped as ambiguous promotional spam; only clean ham (label 0, 10,005 rows) loaded; template dedup reduced to 6,481 non-redundant hams.

scamshield_corpus.excluded_notes: Defect (g) root cause: Although registered in datasets_manifest.json (69,286 rows) as use=fit, round 1 build_corpus.py load_sources() completely lacked an ingestion block for scamshield-dataset, resulting in 0 rows entering train/val partitions.

bengali_sms_smishing_dataset.excluded_notes: Round 1 declared use=diagnostic only (Bangladesh +880 mobile context). Excluded from round 1 fitting.

trilingual_fraud_consumer_protection_v2.excluded_notes: Held-out frozen development challenge set by Karan Verma. Never fitted on.

indic_test_suite_clean.excluded_notes: Frozen multi-language challenge subset (100 rows each for bn, hi, hi-latn, en). Never fitted on.
